environment.description: Tomcat 9.0 application server running on EC2 instance in a public subnet. Application Load Balancer forwards all traffic on port 443 to target group on port 8080. ALB listener has no additional rule actions beyond default forward. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0 on ALB, and 8080 from ALB security group on EC2. PostgreSQL RDS instance in private subnet, security group allows 5432 from EC2 security group. No AWS WAF WebACL is associated with the ALB. The database user configured in the JNDI datasource has SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE privileges on all tables in the public schema. CloudWatch agent collects application logs.

config.db_user_privileges: SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public
